data.long_meaning: In Greek, Lelah means 'God's Hidden One' or 'God's Secret One'. This name is derived from the Greek word 'elas', which means 'hidden'. The name Lelah is often used in Christian spiritual traditions for those who wish to remain humbly devoted and hidden in their faith. The name Lelah carries the meaning “God's Hidden One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lelah usually hope their child will grow to embody god's hidden one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Λελά
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name לֵלָה (Lelah). In the Septuagint, the Greek translation of the Old Testament, this name is transliterated as Λελά (Lelá).

in_latin.name: Lelah

in_english.name: Lelah
